subject: CALL statement
notes: CROSS-CLUSTER CLOSURE AT LANDING TRAIN 4 (kb/Work PB238 + PB237, landed together). Rule (cite.py OK, 14.9.4.4 rule 9): a)1 'if the argument meets the requirements of Syntax rule 3, BY REFERENCE is assumed'; a)2 'if the argument does not meet the requirements of Syntax rule 3, BY CONTENT is assumed'; b) 'when the BY VALUE phrase is specified or implied for the corresponding formal parameter, BY VALUE is assumed'. All three legs now have a witness on ONE tree. LEG a)1 - an argument that MEETS 14.9.4.3 SR3 ('an address-identifier or a data item defined in the file, working-storage, local-storage, or linkage section') is identifier-2 and keeps BY REFERENCE: pb238_call_format2_operands' bare data-item arguments and pb237_program_prototype's CALL-1 / CALL-2 legs, whose 14.2.3 GR8 writeback is what makes WS-CALLS advance 0->1->2 across activations. LEG a)2 - an argument that does NOT meet SR3 takes BY CONTENT: pb238_call_format2_operands S3 (a constant-name substitutes literal 42 per 13.10.4 GR1/GR2, and a literal never meets SR3) and pb238_call_sr20_object_property (an object property is not a data item of those four sections; 14.9.4.3 SR20 names it as the one receiving-permitted identifier for which BY CONTENT may be omitted). LEG b) - THE LEG THAT WAS OPEN, and it needed a PROTOTYPE formal to read. On PB238's own tree a formal existed only under AS NESTED because 12.3.8.2's REPOSITORY program-specifier had no grammar. PB237 lands that specifier in the same train, so the leg is now witnessed by a genuine program prototype: 2002/pb237_program_prototype declares PROGRAM SCALE-IT AS "PB237MUL"; PB237MUL is PROCEDURE DIVISION USING BY VALUE LK-V RETURNING LK-R; and the keyword-less CALL SCALE-IT USING WS-N RETURNING WS-OUT prints SCALED =0004 with UNCHG  =0002. The unchanged caller operand is the witness: it is correct ONLY if GR9 b) derived BY VALUE from the PROTOTYPE's corresponding formal (ResolvePrototype -> callee ??= proto2.Signature -> calleeFormals -> Gr9NonIdentifierMode) and 14.2.3 GR10's detached value copy then kept the callee's stores off the caller. The row was moved onto PB237 by PB238's branch precisely so that the note able to close it would own it; it is closed here on the merged tree.
